# Runway API

Skills that teach agents to work with Runway API. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [runwayml/skills](https://github.com/runwayml/skills), at commit `6e98d3f`.

Get guidance for integrating video, image and audio generation with the Runway API and official SDKs.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Runway API**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Runway API**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install runway-api@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

7 skills: `runway-dev`, `runway-dev-characters`, `runway-dev-model-routers`, `runway-dev-models`, `runway-dev-recipes`, `runway-dev-setup`, `runway-dev-workflows`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
